simon_customer: Hi — our org upgraded from Pro to Enterprise mid-cycle yesterday and our monthly token bucket dropped to 0 at midnight and hasn't refilled. UI says 0 and API returns 429 even though we bought more credits. Can someone explain?
jordan_support: sorry for the trouble — can you share the org id and a request id that got a 429?
simon_customer: org: acme-32, got 429 on request x-request-id=01FZ9A7J9K, timestamp 2025-10-27T00:02:13Z. We expected the bucket to be prorated and increase immediately after purchase.
maria_billing: tagging in billing. Upgrades mid-cycle trigger proration, but we should still apply the pro-rated tokens immediately. I'll check invoice state.
maria_billing: billing-bot reports: invoice status=processing, credit_adjustment=pending, proration_amount_usd=+150.00. The adjustment hasn't been applied because invoice finalization job is queued.
alex_eng_oncall: quick check — our quota refresh job has a guard that waits for invoice finalization if a billing event occurred within the last 2 hours for that org. It's intended to avoid double-applying credits during late adjustments.
jordan_support: can we confirm whether that guard is too conservative? Customer says they bought in UI at 23:40 local and saw zero at 00:00.
alex_eng_oncall: looking at logs for acme-32: 
```
[2025-10-27T00:00:00Z] quota-refresh-trigger org=acme-32 trigger=midnight-rollover
[2025-10-27T00:00:01Z] billing-event-detected org=acme-32 event=upgrade plan=enterprise status=invoice_processing
[2025-10-27T00:00:02Z] quota-refresh-skip reason=billing_pending
[2025-10-27T00:05:10Z] invoice-finalize job scheduled job_id=job-9942
```
Looks like the refresh skipped because billing event was detected before the invoice finalized.
maria_billing: invoice svc shows finalized at 2025-10-27T00:10:08Z, adjustment applied. But the quota-refresh job doesn't automatically re-run for skipped orgs.
jordan_support: so the net effect is: upgrade -> billing pending -> midnight quota refresh skipped -> invoice finalizes later -> no auto-retry -> customer stuck at 0 until next midnight or manual fix. Not ideal.
simon_customer: that's exactly what happened. We were blocked for ~30m and it killed our demo. Any manual fix we can do now?
alex_eng_oncall: I can trigger a manual reconcile for acme-32: `POST /internal/admin/reconcile_quota?org=acme-32` with idempotency. That will apply the prorated tokens immediately. I'll run it now and follow up when done.
alex_eng_oncall: reconciled — response: 200 OK, added 12,500 tokens (prorated). Please retry.
simon_customer: confirmed, API calls are succeeding again. Thanks.
jordan_support: root cause: quota-refresh job has an overly-broad billing_pending skip window. Remediation: engineering to add an automatic retry queue for skipped orgs when invoice finalizes, and short-term workaround to let billing finalize faster or trigger reconcile_quota from billing pipeline.
maria_billing: opened billing ticket BL-781 to add a webhook to call the reconcile endpoint on invoice finalize for upgrades.
alex_eng_oncall: i'll file an eng ticket ENG-1429 to change the midnight-refresh behavior: if billing_pending is detected, mark org for immediate follow-up instead of skipping silently.
jordan_support: advice for support triage SOP: when a customer reports post-upgrade zero bucket, ask for org id + request id, check `billing-event` + `quota-refresh-skip` logs, and if invoice finalized, run `reconcile_quota`. Adding snippet to KB: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/reconcile_quota?org=ORG_ID"`
simon_customer: appreciated. can you note this caused customer-visible downtime for our demo? we'll follow up with your account team about SLA credits.
jordan_support: noted and escalating to accounts for potential service credit. :nod:
billing-bot: Ticket BL-781 created by maria_billing for webhook on invoice finalize -> reconcile_quota.
